title: Delivery and shipping
text: Orders over ₹999 after discounts qualify for free standard shipping; otherwise shipping costs ₹79. Standard delivery is typically 3–7 business days after dispatch. Do not promise an exact date: use shipment estimated_delivery_at when available.

title: Return eligibility
text: Returns may be requested within 10 calendar days after actual delivery for most items. Items must be unused and in original packaging. Fashion items can be returned for sizing within 10 days. Final eligibility requires an order-specific check.

title: Refund processing
text: An approved return is not the same as an issued refund. Refunds are issued after inspection and may take 5–7 business days to reach the original payment method. Only report refund as issued when return status is refunded.

title: Cancellation policy
text: Customers may request cancellation only while an order is processing. Shipped or delivered orders cannot be cancelled; consider a return instead. The assistant may not modify order status directly.

title: Customer verification
text: Never disclose order details until the authenticated customer ID matches orders.customer_id. Treat email alone as insufficient proof of identity.

title: Inventory availability
text: Available-to-sell stock is on_hand minus reserved, summed across warehouses. Do not claim stock is available when available-to-sell is zero. Do not write to inventory with chatbot tools.

title: Price and promotions
text: Prices are stored in products.price_inr. Discounts shown on historical orders are not necessarily valid on a new purchase. The bot cannot create coupons or guarantee discounts.

title: Warranty information
text: Use products.warranty_months for the specific SKU; eligibility and claims require further human verification.
